DIAS IPU Admission 2026 – Complete Guide

About DIAS – Delhi Institute of Advanced Studies

Delhi Institute of Advanced Studies (DIAS) is a well-established management and professional studies institution located in Sector-25, Rohini, New Delhi. Affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) and accredited by the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC), DIAS has positioned itself as one of the trusted names for management education in Delhi.

Founded with the objective of nurturing future business leaders and professionals, DIAS offers a blend of academic rigour and industry-oriented learning. The institute maintains close ties with the corporate world through regular guest lectures, industry visits, live projects, and internship programmes. The NAAC accreditation is a testament to the quality standards maintained by the institution across teaching, research, and infrastructure.

DIAS is particularly well-regarded for its BBA programme, attracting students from across Delhi-NCR seeking quality management education at a reasonable cost under the IPU framework. The college also offers a B.Com programme. For free admission guidance and counselling, call 9899991342.

Courses Offered at DIAS

Programme Duration Seats (Approx)
BBA 3 Years 80

MBA (Master of Business Administration) 2 Years 60

DIAS Admission Process 2026

Admission to DIAS follows the centralised GGSIPU counselling process. Candidates must appear for IPU CET or CUET and register on the GGSIPU counselling portal. Seat allotment is based on entrance exam rank, category, and preference order.

  1. Appear for IPU CET or CUET entrance exam
  2. Register on the GGSIPU online counselling portal
  3. Fill in DIAS as a preference during choice filling
  4. Attend document verification upon seat allotment
  5. Pay the admission fee to confirm your seat

Management quota seats may also be available. For complete admission support, call 9899991342.

Placements at DIAS

DIAS has a strong placement record among IPU-affiliated colleges. Key highlights:

  • Average Package: 4-7 LPA
  • Top Recruiters: Deloitte, KPMG, ICICI Bank, HDFC, Kotak Mahindra
  • Placement Rate: 82-88%
  • Key Sectors: Banking, Finance, Consulting, IT Services, FMCG

Campus Life at DIAS

  • Air-conditioned classrooms with audio-visual equipment
  • Management resource centre (library) with journals and e-resources
  • Modern computer lab with internet connectivity
  • Conference hall and seminar rooms
  • Cafeteria and recreational areas
  • Sports facilities
  • Active student clubs for marketing, finance, and entrepreneurship
  • Regular industry visits and corporate interactions

DIAS is a top choice for students targeting admission under IPU. For personalised admission guidance, call 9899991342 today.
